description: Repairs r-dao-1b/coll-delete-field-indexed: every field tried was indexed or in a relation, so no successful Fields.Delete was captured. On a writable copy, TableDef Typed (primary key K; the other fields are in no index and no relation; one row): Fields Count and names, Indexes Count and names, Relations Count; Fields.Delete('TText'), Errors; the same reads (before Refresh); Fields.Refresh; the same reads; a fresh Fields collection read; Fields.Item('TText') read, Errors; Fields.Delete('TOle'), Errors, the same reads after Refresh; a snapshot on Typed reads the row and its field names. Asks whether a field in no index and no relation can be deleted, when the collection shows it, and what is left of the row. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
